subject: mittens
name: Mittens — an economical sepia drawing with connected light washes

styleSelection.reason: The target is a high-key fine-line portrait sketch. Thin lids, whiskers, fur growth and curls need drawing over a local-colour foundation and one coherent dry shadow glaze, without tiled middle-value layers.

families.referenceCue: Tall ears, upward gaze, pale green-gold iris and warm tabby patches. Controlled watery wash on dry paper; fine lids and directional whiskers in sepia; muzzle and glints kept light.
Large irregular white bib, warm orange flank and oblique tabby bands. Connected local wash with lost light edges; a dry cross-boundary shadow and a few directional lines, no stippling.
Almost-white forehead and nose ridge, pale warm cheek planes, gentle sockets and smile. Watery transparent skin wash on dry paper; upper lids in fine ink; lower lids stay quiet.
Connected charcoal curls with irregular paper gaps. Payne grey, sepia and ultramarine carry the dark mass; one dry glaze and sparse curved drawing, never ink filling.
